The '''Quadrilateral Forum''' was a section of the "[[Green Ellipse]]," a ruined city on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Asation]]. The Forum was located west of the [[Xenoform Marshes]]<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Quadrilateral Forum first appears in the Operation "Terror From Beyond" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=operation|Terror From Beyond}}</ref>
